name: Floating Market of Dreamcatchers
description: A night market suspended in the sky, stalls selling glowing dreamcatchers that project miniature visions.
prompt: A bustling market floating among clouds at twilight. Stalls are woven from vines and lanterns. Each stall displays dreamcatchers that emit tiny holographic scenes — forests, oceans, cities — rotating slowly. Shoppers of diverse ages wander. Warm lantern light, magical realism, detailed textures, wide perspective.
caption: Catch a dream, take it home 🌙🕸️ #DreamMarket
